current.text: Detroit acquired him from Oklahoma City in a trade this offseason.
He is projected as Detroit's sixth man and backup shooter, first off the bench.
Duncan Robinson is projected to start ahead of him.
He is the most likely challenger to Duncan Robinson for the starting spot.
Detroit used a deep 12 to 13 player rotation last season, and that limited everyone's minutes.
He ranks outside the top 250 for fantasy, with value around 250. He is a three-point streamer, not a draft pick.
Detroit plays 4-3-4 games in our playoff weeks and has 15 back-to-backs. No rest risks are expected.

durable.text: He is an elite three-point shooter with low usage who adds little else.
He is a strong regular-season shooter who can get hot from three.
His defense kept him off the floor in OKC's last two playoff runs, and he fell out of their playoff rotation.
He has some impact creating turnovers on defense.
